verdict.rationale: Unity documents a first-party package ecosystem: the Package Manager 'delivers a wide range of enhancements', and the public UPM registry resolves packages such as AI Assistant and Sentis. Community posts referencing third-party plugins (e.g., VLC-Unity) on 'their Store' corroborate that an asset store distributes plugins. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the Asset Store itself, evidence of its scale ('large') and of ready-made models/art assets, independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.
